rules.title: Armor, ArmorAddon and NIF slots disagree

detection.algorithm: Compare ARMO body mask, linked ARMA masks/races, and NIF skin partitions for every generated armor variant.

fix_policy.algorithm: Reconcile the intended numeric slot mask and regenerate affected mesh outputs.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Condition patch loses CTDA semantics
rules.bad_pattern: Function/value is forwarded without preserving comparison flags, parameter interpretation, Run On, reference, parameter 3, or ordering/OR semantics.
rules.why: CTDA behavior depends on the entire encoded predicate, not just visible function name.

detection.algorithm: Normalize and compare full CTDA tuples using xEdit schema; flag partial field copies and changed OR ordering.

fix_policy.algorithm: Copy/rebuild the entire intended predicate or regenerate from typed condition model.

rules.title: Native SKSE plugin runtime/API mismatch

detection.algorithm: Compare active executable/SKSE/Address Library against DLL metadata, dependencies and startup log.
false_positive_exclusions: optional integration disabled on this runtime

fix_policy.algorithm: Install/build the correct runtime binary or narrow the supported runtime matrix.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Generated output is stale

detection.algorithm: Compare recorded input hashes, settings and load-order epoch against current dependency graph.
false_positive_exclusions: frozen vendor artifact not generated by this project

fix_policy.algorithm: Remove only stale generated staging output, rerun its generator, validate, then rebuild downstream dependents.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Referenced required asset is missing
rules.bad_pattern: Resolved VFS/package contains no file at the required path.
rules.why: Missing models/textures/scripts/voice/UI files cause visible failure or runtime errors.

detection.algorithm: Build path-closure graph from plugin/NIF/config/UI references and resolve against actual deployed/VFS winners.

fix_policy.algorithm: If missing file is a declared generated output, regenerate it; otherwise block and identify missing source/dependency.

rules.title: Declared native runtime target was not built and verified
preconditions: Project manifest declares more than one Skyrim runtime/distribution target for a native DLL
rules.bad_pattern: Release artifact is promoted after building/testing only a subset of the declared target matrix.
rules.why: CommonLib abstractions and one successful binary do not prove every runtime's relocations, ABI, metadata, imports and hooks are valid.

detection.algorithm: Compare project target matrix against CMake preset/configure/build records, output DLL hashes, metadata/import scans and runtime smoke results. Every declared target must have an explicit pass, supported universal-binary proof, or removal from the support claim.
false_positive_exclusions: single verified universal binary whose exact declared runtime coverage is independently confirmed

fix_policy.algorithm: Build and validate missing target(s), narrow the published support matrix, or supply a verified universal binary with exact runtime guards.
postconditions: all published targets have build evidence
all release-native targets have load/init evidence

evidence.notes: G09 already requires every declared target build; this rule makes incomplete matrices machine-detectable.

rules.title: Deleted navmesh detected

detection.algorithm: Scan touched NAVM records for the Deleted record flag and report cell/worldspace plus override chain.

fix_policy.algorithm: Repair through a navmesh-safe CK/xEdit workflow; do not apply ordinary UDR logic.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: NIF references missing texture

detection.algorithm: Parse winning NIF shader paths and resolve every required texture through the effective VFS/BSA asset set.
false_positive_exclusions: unused shader slots for the active shader type

fix_policy.algorithm: Correct the path or stage the intended asset.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: NPC record and FaceGen winners disagree

detection.algorithm: Join the winning NPC_ appearance record to winning FaceGeom and FaceTint files in the VFS and compare intended appearance provenance.

fix_policy.algorithm: Forward one coherent appearance source and matching FaceGen, or deliberately regenerate from the final NPC record.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Multiple OAR candidates match unexpectedly
preconditions: More than one submod can match same animation context
rules.bad_pattern: Final selection depends on priority/order not declared as intentional by the project.
rules.why: Animation can appear inconsistent when overlapping conditions are not understood.

detection.algorithm: Evaluate project OAR condition models against fixture actors/states; list all matching candidates and priority winner.

fix_policy.algorithm: Refine conditions or document priority relationship.

rules.title: Native Papyrus function provider missing

detection.algorithm: Map used native declarations to provider DLLs and compare against effective SKSE layer and load logs.
false_positive_exclusions: optional integrations guarded by provider detection

fix_policy.algorithm: Install/build the correct provider or remove/guard the optional native call.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Duplicate record identity in semantic plugin view

detection.algorithm: Within one semantic plugin view require each signature/FormKey pair to be unique.

fix_policy.algorithm: Identify producer duplication or conflicting generated records and regenerate without duplicate identity.

rules.title: Invalid light-plugin FormID range

detection.algorithm: Read TES4 light flag/header and every new-form local ObjectID; validate against the target header/runtime range.

fix_policy.algorithm: Compact/recreate only when project policy permits; otherwise change plugin kind.
postconditions: external FormID-dependent artifacts are migrated or proven unaffected

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: New regular-plugin record uses low reserved-style local ID

detection.algorithm: For non-light output plugins other than Skyrim.esm, flag newly owned local IDs below 0x800 for review.
false_positive_exclusions: validated intentional conversion or legacy fixture

fix_policy.algorithm: Regenerate with normal new-record allocation unless the low ID is intentionally preserved and independently validated.
postconditions: new regular-plugin IDs satisfy project allocation policy

evidence.notes: Documents conventional 0x800 floor for regular plugin local IDs.

rules.title: Override origin is not declared as a master

detection.algorithm: For every record whose canonical FormKey origin differs from the output plugin, require that origin ModKey in the declared master set.

fix_policy.algorithm: Add only the actually required master or remove the unintended override/reference.
postconditions: all external record origins resolve through declared masters

rules.title: Semantic plugin record identity is not canonical

detection.algorithm: Require six-hex-digit local ID plus origin ModKey identity before cross-load-order or cross-oracle comparison.
false_positive_exclusions: explicit load-order-scoped diagnostic artifacts that are not used for canonical comparison

fix_policy.algorithm: Resolve displayed FormIDs through the pinned load-order/master map or re-emit through a canonical FormKey-aware parser.
postconditions: every compared record has canonical FormKey identity

evidence.notes: Mutagen FormKey is load-order-independent and serializes as six hex digits plus origin ModKey.

rules.title: Unresolved plugin FormLink

detection.algorithm: Load output with xEdit and a typed parser; enumerate unresolved FormLinks and missing masters; report selected and parsed denominators.

fix_policy.algorithm: Resolve the intended FormKey/master without renumbering unrelated forms.
postconditions: typed parser resolves every non-null FormLink

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Runtime harness assertion may be answering from stale or wrong game state
preconditions: Automated runtime harness communicates with a running Skyrim process through files, probe IPC, logs or detached session state
rules.bad_pattern: A test passes using stale probe/log data, another Skyrim process, an old session, or pre-trigger evidence instead of the test launch being asserted.
rules.why: Detached/headless automation can produce false positives if evidence is not session-scoped and freshness-checked.

detection.algorithm: Require unique session/build id, process identity, launch timestamp/marker, runtime/version match, evidence mtime/sequence after trigger, read-act-wait-read state transition, and—where feasible—an A/B vanilla control. Reject pre-launch or already-consumed evidence.

fix_policy.algorithm: Reset test/probe IO, stop stale sessions, rebuild isolated test profile, relaunch, and rerun the failed scenario from a clean fixture. Escalate if process/profile ownership is ambiguous.
postconditions: all evidence belongs to current session
assertion observes a post-trigger state change

evidence.notes: Skytest documents stale shared-probe/log and second-running-game failure modes and uses launch markers/session guards.
Repository requires read-act-wait-read assertions.

rules.title: Runtime state diverges from static winner

detection.algorithm: Compare static winner with runtime-patcher configs/logs, save/ExtraData state and a live query; construct the final provenance chain.

fix_policy.algorithm: Patch/configure the actual owning layer and document the runtime provenance.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Spriggit plugin round-trip changes undeclared semantics
preconditions: A plugin is serialized/deserialized through Spriggit or another text interchange representation
rules.bad_pattern: Binary -> text -> binary round-trip produces semantic record/field changes outside the declared project touch-set.
rules.why: Git-friendly representation is valuable, but serializer/deserializer coverage or translation-version differences must not silently alter plugin semantics.

detection.algorithm: Serialize the source plugin, deserialize to a second staged binary, load both with independent parsers, normalize records/FormLinks/order-insensitive collections, then compare semantic fingerprints and declared touch-set. Preserve translation package/version.
false_positive_exclusions: documented normalization differences proven semantically equivalent

fix_policy.algorithm: Pin a compatible translation package/version, isolate the differing record/field, and keep the original binary authoritative until independent parsers prove semantic equivalence.
postconditions: xEdit and Mutagen both load output

evidence.notes: Spriggit is a plugin-to-YAML/JSON round-trip tool with versioned translation packages.
Repository requires independent plugin round-trip validation.

rules.title: Validator processed less input than expected

detection.algorithm: Compare independently discovered input count with processed, skipped and errored counts; require every difference to be classified.
false_positive_exclusions: documented scope filter applied before both denominator and numerator

fix_policy.algorithm: Invalidate the result, repair discovery/parser coverage or emit explicit unsupported/skipped items, then rerun.
postconditions: processed plus classified skipped equals discovered

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Papyrus VMAD property binding mismatch

detection.algorithm: Compare VMAD script/property metadata with pinned PSC/PEX declarations and inheritance; find stale, incompatible or required-unfilled properties.

fix_policy.algorithm: Update bindings or restore a compatible script schema; handle existing-save migration separately.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Dialogue voice asset identity mismatch

detection.algorithm: Derive expected voice asset identity from final INFO/plugin/VoiceType/response and resolve packaged FUZ/XWM/LIP assets.

fix_policy.algorithm: Regenerate/package voice output from the final dialogue identity.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.

rules.title: Skyrim SE cell water-flow data reverted

detection.algorithm: Compare water/flow fields in exterior CELL overrides against Update.esm or the selected water-overhaul truth source while ignoring unrelated fields.
false_positive_exclusions: project declares a complete replacement water model

fix_policy.algorithm: Forward only the intended water/flow fields from the chosen truth source.

evidence.notes: Validated for inclusion in the core Agent OS prevention pack on 2026-09-24.
